_comment: Config for the --interview two-call Medium flow in scripts/produce_blog.py. Edit freely; values fill the {{PLACEHOLDERS}} in prompts/question_generator.md and prompts/article_writer.md. Env vars override any field: INTERVIEW_NICHE, INTERVIEW_AUDIENCE, INTERVIEW_AUTHOR_VOICE, INTERVIEW_EMAIL_CTA_TARGET (apply to whichever niche is being produced).

defaults.AUTHOR_VOICE: Analytical but warm. Personal examples. Direct, no fluff, no jargon without context. Banned words: 'In conclusion', 'Dive into', 'Leverage', 'Game-changer', 'Synergy'.
defaults.EMAIL_CTA_TARGET: the email list / free worksheet at the end of the post

ds.AUDIENCE: working data scientists, analysts, and ML engineers who want practical, build-it-now value
ds.EMAIL_CTA_TARGET: the free companion worksheet + email list (data science)

life.AUDIENCE: thoughtful people working on focus, discipline, and personal growth who are tired of recycled productivity advice
life.EMAIL_CTA_TARGET: the free companion worksheet + email list (life & self-development)

poetry.AUDIENCE: readers who come to Medium for poems and short, honest reflections on life, grief, and growth
poetry.EMAIL_CTA_TARGET: the email list for new poems and reflections
